subject: Reconcile PO mandate for SkyGrid pilot — request for conditional invoice-only allowance
messages:
From: Emma Brown <emma@skygrid.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, procurement@skygrid.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice-only for SkyGrid pilot

Hi Soojin / Redwood procurement team,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — the engineers are excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. A quick ask from our side: our procurement policy on the vendor side takes time to generate a PO, and the pilot needs to start next week. Would Redwood consider a temporary invoice-only path for the pilot period (no PO required) while the procurement paperwork is processed?

I attached the completed onboarding form and the pilot SOW. We anticipate ~ $2.5k total for week 1 usage, scaling possibly to ~$6k/month if the pilot expands. If a spend cap / evidence requirements help, we can comply.

What info do you need to move forward?

Best,
Emma Brown
Head of Ops, SkyGrid AI
Attachments: SkyGrid_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf, SOW_SkyGrid_Pilot.docx

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Emma Brown <emma@skygrid.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only for SkyGrid pilot

Hi Emma — thanks for sending the forms and the SOW. Quick internal note: our default is PO-first for new vendors, but we do have a limited invoice-only corridor for pilots under certain controls. I'm looping Finance and Procurement to scope the guardrails.

High level we need to confirm 3 things:
- a temporary spend cap and who owns escalation if usage exceeds it (suggestion: $5k/month cap during pilot)
- a named billing contact + remit email on your side (we have procurement@skygrid.ai but prefer a person for follow-ups)
- acceptance of our temporary terms (I can circulate a 1-page temporary invoice-only addendum)

David / Marissa — any objections to a conditional invoice-only allowance for SkyGrid while vendor setup is completed? If acceptable, I'll request Procurement to mark the vendor as "pilot-invoice-allowlist" and capture the controls.

So that we move quickly, Emma — can you confirm the billing contact and accept the cap + addendum?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T12:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only for SkyGrid pilot

On 2027-04-18 10:03, soojin_lee@redwood.com wrote:
> David / Marissa — any objections to a conditional invoice-only allowance for SkyGrid while vendor setup is completed?

Quick finance take: fine with a controlled exception provided the following are in place before first invoice is paid:
1) Pilot spend cap: $5,000/month (hard cap) and automated alerts to finance at 80% usage
2) Signed one-page invoice-only addendum acknowledging Redwood's standard payment terms and acceptance of monthly invoices to AP@redwood.com
3) Billing contact with a copy of the vendor W-9 / tax form or equivalent (or EEA VAT docs if applicable)
4) Procurement to tag vendor record as: pilot-invoice-allowlist — expire after 8 weeks unless renewed via PO or extended approval

If any of that is missing, we hold payment until evidence is provided. Happy to approve the exception once we get the addendum + billing contact.

-David
David Kim | Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, Emma Brown <emma@skygrid.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only for SkyGrid pilot

Thanks for the clear proposal. Marissa here — I approve a conditional exception for SkyGrid with two operational conditions:

1) The pilot-invoice-allowlist tag must include the explicit expiry date (2027-06-06) and auto-renew only with documented approval from Procurement Director.
2) The addendum must include a clause: any overage above $5k/month requires written approval from the Account Executive (Soojin) + Finance (David) before services continue; vendor must pause provisioning if overage occurs and we haven't signed off.

Soojin — please capture the addendum and procurement tag. Procurement team, please proceed to create vendor record as pilot-invoice-allowlist once the addendum + billing contact + W-9 are on file.

-Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Operations

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: procurement@redwood.com, Emma Brown <emma@skygrid.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-19T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Final: SkyGrid pilot — next steps and DocuSign link

Emma — thanks, that aligns with us. Quick summary and asks so Procurement can act:

Summary of agreed temporary path:
- Exception: invoice-only for pilot (no PO) from 2027-04-19 through 2027-06-06
- Spend cap: $5,000/month; 80% alert to Finance; vendor tagged pilot-invoice-allowlist
- Required docs before first invoice: signed invoice-only addendum (DocuSign link below), billing contact, W-9/tax form
- Overages: vendor pauses provisioning until written sign-off from Soojin + David

Emma — please sign the addendum here: https://docusign.com/redsandbox/Sign?doc=SG-4589-addendum
Also reply with a named billing contact (full name + email) and attach W-9. Procurement, please create vendor entry with tag pilot-invoice-allowlist and set expiry 2027-06-06 (auto-notify team 7 days before expiry).

I'll monitor usage during week 1 and escalate immediately if we hit 80%.

Thanks all — will update HubSpot once vendor is live.

Cheers,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
